title: Freight Desk Manager
description: Position Scope The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding. Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers. Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency. Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards. Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments. Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes. Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency. Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Mandatory Requirements Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments. Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks. Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes. Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operationalmodels. Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree. Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description: JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company. The Role As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription. Please share your resume in English. Responsibilities: Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage. Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes. Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits. Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources. Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams. Requirements: A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines. Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred. Fluent communication skills English. Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.E. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology. Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building. Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred. Why Join JoVE? You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market. You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education. Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Web Content Editor / Web Qa (Growth Role)
description: Location: Brazil Team: Digital / Web Company Description Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity. Role Overview We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time. You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks. You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience. Key Responsibilities: Content Editing & Publishing Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines. Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages. Manage and update content within a CMS (e.G., Sanity, WordPress, or similar). Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders. Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates. UX, Accessibility & Content Quality Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization. Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.G., alt text, content structure, readability). Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization. Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation. Web QA & Quality Ownership Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards. Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies. Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues. Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content. Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership. Performance & Optimization Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.G., Google Analytics). Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content. Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review. Qualifications & Skills 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations. Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail. Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS). Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments. Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices. Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues. Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance. Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows. Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time. Nice to Have Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes. Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments. Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists. Growth Opportunity This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines,regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimentoprático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimentoem Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Program Coordinator
description: About Sofia Health Sofia Health is a fast-growing wellness marketplace connecting clients with top health and wellness professionals. Through live classes, on-demand content, and 1:1 services, we’re making whole-person care more accessible and helping providers build thriving businesses. Sofia Prime is our flagship wellness membership, offering 300+ live virtual classes every month focused on physical, mental, and emotional well-being—including yoga, meditation, fitness, tai chi, iRest, health coaching, and more. About the Role We’re looking for a Virtual Wellness Program Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of our Sofia Prime program. In this role, you’ll help with day-to-day operations, communicate with instructors, support clients, ensure a seamless experience for both sides of the platform, and help expand participation and engagement across the platform. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role ideal for someone passionate about wellness, tech-enabled solutions, and community building. Responsibilities Coordinate and publish weekly and monthly live class schedules Communicate with wellness instructors to confirm availability, gather class details, and ensure timely updates Provide basic support to clients and instructors (e.G., tech check-ins, live session support, FAQs) Assist with monitoring class attendance and flagging any issues or trends Help gather and organize feedback from members to improve class offerings Collaborate with marketing and community teams to promote upcoming classes Maintain accurate records and help ensure consistent program delivery Requirements 1–3 years of experience in wellness programming, admin coordination, virtual event management, or community support Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through Comfortable using Zoom, Google Suite, and digital scheduling tools Strong written and verbal communication skills Enthusiastic, team-oriented, and passionate about wellness Ability to work independently in a remote environment Bonus Points Experience working at a health tech or wellness startup Background in virtual wellness delivery or e-learning company Familiarity with wellness programming tools and virtual event logistics

title: Especialista Em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. O que Buscamos? O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework. Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura - Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design - Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage - Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS) - Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos - Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering Azure Files - Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS) - Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory - Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso - Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises - Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup Azure Networking – Conceitos principais - Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP - Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall - Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute - Private Endpoints e service endpoints - Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações - Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking - Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher - Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros - Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede Logs e análises - Integração com Log Analytics Workspace - Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL) - Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura - Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais Backup, recuperação e resiliência Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios - Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files - Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault - Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração - Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres - Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware) - Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade - Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos - Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde Segurança, governança e conformidade - Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking - Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito - Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC - Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags - Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas Automação e integração (desejável): - Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep - Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps - Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) - Runbooks operacionais padronizados Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente - Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica - Projetar e validar arquiteturas de armazenamento e rede do Azure - Liderar workshops técnicos e revisões de arquitetura - Apoiar as fases de integração, adoção e otimização - Solucionar problemas em cenários complexos de armazenamento e rede - Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros Perfil de Experiência - Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure - Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes - Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica - Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure - Fortes habilidades de solução de problemas e relacionamento com o cliente Contratação CLT Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens esporádicas) O que oferecemos? title: System Architect
description: Project Description: Owns the end-to-end vision and AI architecture for consumer devices. Defines scalable, power-efficient, and production-ready imaging and perception systems across product lines. Drives technical direction across sensor, ISP, CV, ML, and platform integration. Responsibilities: Define and own end-to-end vision system architecture (sensor → ISP → CV/ML → application layer). Translate product and UX requirements into scalable technical solutions. Define image quality strategy aligned with AI and user experience goals. Architect reusable, modular CV/ML frameworks across multiple product SKUs. Drive system-level trade-offs across performance, power, cost, and thermal limits. Define AI model lifecycle strategy from training to OTA deployment. Architect heterogeneous compute utilization (CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP). Define system KPIs: latency, FPS, power, memory, boot time, and robustness. Lead technology selection for inference engines, frameworks, and hardware platforms. Guide SoC bring-up and performance validation for vision pipelines. Establish coding standards, modularization strategy, and long-term maintainability. Identify technical risks early and define mitigation strategies. Collaborate with hardware, ISP, Android/Linux platform, and product teams. Mentor senior engineers and provide architectural governance. Contribute to long-term vision/AI roadmap across product generations. Mandatory Skills Description: - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (PhD preferred). 10-15+ years of experience in imaging/vision/perception systems. Proven experience architecting and shipping multiple consumer products with vision/AI. Deep understanding of imaging pipeline (sensor behavior, ISP, tuning impact). Strong embedded system architecture experience. Expert-level C++ and system-level optimization knowledge. Strong expertise in CV and ML system integration. Experience deploying optimized ML models on consumer SoCs. Experience with heterogeneous compute architectures. Experience defining system-level KPIs and validation strategies. Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills. Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Talent Data Analyst
description:

Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work. Overview of the role: We are looking for a Talent Data Analyst to join our Talent team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. - Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

title: Jde Cnc Consultant
description:
About Us: Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation. Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning. About the Role: We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation. The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment. Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region. Responsibilities: The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);
Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level. Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management. Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources. Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills. Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis. Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks. Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies. Qualifications & Skills: Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience. Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.G. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous) Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM) Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent. Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written. Technical competence with proven analytical skills. Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas) Systematic approach to problem resolution. Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team. Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands. Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize. Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards. Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook. What we offer: Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence. Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship. Competitive salary and benefits package. Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance. Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: Web3 & Al Investment Analyst
description: Web3DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure. We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet. As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Web3 & AI Investment Analyst to join our team. This is a fully remote position (Poland-based), offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI. This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights. What You’ll Be Doing Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies. Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems. Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays. Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders. Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects. Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning. Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities. What We’re Looking For 2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets. Strong understanding of blockchain, DeFi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems. Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape. Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information. Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities. Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views. Fluent English with strong written communication skills. High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation. Why Join Web3DXB Competitive compensation: BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses. Remote-first: Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours. Direct investment exposure: Work on real deals and high-impact decisions. High-growth environment: Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally. Meritocratic culture: Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes. Long-term upside: Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems. If you’re passionate about Web3, AI, and investing, and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we’d love to connect.

title: Jde Cnc Consultant
description:
About Us: Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation. Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning. Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide. About the Role: We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation. The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment. Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region. Responsibilities: The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);
Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level. title: Lead Crypto Research Analyst
description: About Ideal Concept Holding (ICH) Ideal Concept Holding is a diversified investment group with a robust portfolio spanning retail, construction, real estate, and general trading across the UAE, Turkey, Azerbaijan, and Georgia. As we expand our global footprint, we are integrating digital asset strategies to optimize treasury management, explore tokenization of real-world assets (RWA), and identify high-potential Web3 investment opportunities. We combine traditional business stability with forward-looking technological innovation. Role Overview We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Lead Crypto Research Analyst to head our digital assets research initiative. Based remotely in Brazil, you will serve as the primary intelligence source for the executive team, identifying emerging trends, evaluating early-stage Web3 projects, and providing data-driven recommendations for capital allocation. This is not a trading role. It is a fundamental research position focused on due diligence, risk assessment, and strategic advisory. You will help ICH navigate the complex landscape of blockchain technology, ensuring that our exposure to digital assets is compliant, secure, and aligned with long-term corporate goals. Key Responsibilities Fundamental Research & Due Diligence: Conduct deep-dive analysis of Web3 sectors (DeFi, Infrastructure, RWA, Layer 2s, Gaming). Evaluate projects based on technology, team credibility, tokenomics, and market fit. Investment Thesis Development: Create and maintain actionable investment theses for the CIO and Board. Identify undervalued opportunities and potential risks in the crypto market. On-Chain Analytics: Utilize tools like Dune Analytics, Nansen, Etherscan, and DefiLlama to verify project metrics, track user growth, monitor whale activity, and assess network health. Tokenomics Modeling: Analyze token distribution models, vesting schedules, inflation rates, and utility mechanisms to identify sustainable projects vs. speculative pumps. Executive Reporting: Prepare concise, high-impact investment memorandums and weekly market intelligence briefings for senior leadership. Regulatory & Risk Monitoring: Stay updated on global regulatory developments (including Brazil’s CVM guidelines, MiCA in EU, and VARA in UAE) and assess their impact on ICH’s strategy. Portfolio Support: Monitor existing digital asset holdings or pilot projects, providing regular performance reports and rebalancing recommendations. Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of experience in financial research, equity analysis, or venture capital, with at least 2–3 years specifically focused on Crypto/Web3 assets. Technical Depth: Strong understanding of blockchain fundamentals (consensus mechanisms, smart contracts, DeFi primitives, ZK-proofs). Ability to read technical whitepapers and audit reports. Analytical Skills: Proficiency in financial modeling (Excel/Google Sheets) and on-chain data analysis tools (Dune, Nansen, Arkham, Glassnode). SQL or Python skills are a strong plus. Market Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the global crypto landscape, including key players, narratives (e.G., RWA, AI x Crypto), and market cycles. Communication: Exceptional written English for reporting to international executives. Portuguese is native/preferred for local coordination. Integrity: High ethical standards and attention to detail. You are skeptical by nature and rely on data, not hype. Compensation & Benefits Competitive Salary: $105,000 - $150,000 USD per year (adjusted for experience and location). Performance Bonus: Annual bonus tied to the accuracy of research insights and successful identification of opportunities. Flexible

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Analytical Skills: Proficiency in financial modeling (Excel/Google Sheets) and on-chain data analysis tools (Dune, Nansen, Arkham, Glassnode). SQL or Python skills are a strong plus. Market Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the global crypto landscape, including key players, narratives (e.G., RWA, AI x Crypto), and market cycles. Communication: Exceptional written English for reporting to international executives. Portuguese is native/preferred for local coordination. Integrity: High ethical standards and attention to detail. You are skeptical by nature and rely on data, not hype. Compensation & Benefits Competitive Salary: $105,000 - $150,000 USD per year (adjusted for experience and location). description: About Ideal Concept Holding (ICH) Ideal Concept Holding is a diversified investment group with a robust portfolio spanning retail, construction, real estate, and general trading across the UAE, Turkey, Azerbaijan, and Georgia. As we expand our global footprint, we are integrating digital asset strategies to optimize treasury management, explore tokenization of real-world assets (RWA), and identify high-potential Web3 investment opportunities. Based remotely in Brazil, you will serve as the primary intelligence source for the executive team, identifying emerging trends, evaluating early-stage Web3 projects, and providing data-driven recommendations for capital allocation. Evaluate projects based on technology, team credibility, tokenomics, and market fit. Investment Thesis Development: Create and maintain actionable investment theses for the CIO and Board. Identify undervalued opportunities and potential risks in the crypto market. On-Chain Analytics: Utilize tools like Dune Analytics, Nansen, Etherscan, and DefiLlama to verify project metrics, track user growth, monitor whale activity, and assess network health. Tokenomics Modeling: Analyze token distribution models, vesting schedules, inflation rates, and utility mechanisms to identify sustainable projects vs. speculative pumps. Regulatory & Risk Monitoring: Stay updated on global regulatory developments (including Brazil’s CVM guidelines, MiCA in EU, and VARA in UAE) and assess their impact on ICH’s strategy. Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of experience in financial research, equity analysis, or venture capital, with at least 2–3 years specifically focused on Crypto/Web3 assets. Technical Depth: Strong understanding of blockchain fundamentals (consensus mechanisms, smart contracts, DeFi primitives, ZK-proofs). Ability to read technical whitepapers and audit reports. Analytical Skills: Proficiency in financial modeling (Excel/Google Sheets) and on-chain data analysis tools (Dune, Nansen, Arkham, Glassnode). SQL or Python skills are a strong plus. Market Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the global crypto landscape, including key players, narratives (e.G., RWA, AI x Crypto), and market cycles. Communication: Exceptional written English for reporting to international executives. Portuguese is native/preferred for local coordination. Integrity: High ethical standards and attention to detail. You are skeptical by nature and rely on data, not hype. Compensation & Benefits Competitive Salary: $105,000 - $150,000 USD per year (adjusted for experience and location). Performance Bonus: Annual bonus tied to the accuracy of research insights and successful identification of opportunities. Flexible

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers, and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end. Key Responsibilities: Team Leadership Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation. Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads. Technical Oversight Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading, Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues. Problem Design (Individual Contribution) Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain. Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions. Electrical Engineering Subdomains: You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus: Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation. Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization. RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design. Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation. At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role. Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows. Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments. Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs. Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.G., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar). Nice-to-Have: Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks. Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation. Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems. Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form. After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

description: About RateGain RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world's largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world's largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business. The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond. This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. description: About Ideal Concept Holding (ICH) Ideal Concept Holding is a diversified investment group with a robust portfolio spanning retail, construction, real estate, and general trading across the UAE, Turkey, Azerbaijan, and Georgia. As we expand our global footprint, we are integrating digital asset strategies to optimize treasury management, explore tokenization of real-world assets (RWA), and identify high-potential Web3 investment opportunities. We combine traditional business stability with forward-looking technological innovation. Role Overview We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Lead Crypto Research Analyst to head our digital assets research initiative. Based remotely in Brazil, you will serve as the primary intelligence source for the executive team, identifying emerging trends, evaluating early-stage Web3 projects, and providing data-driven recommendations for capital allocation. This is not a trading role. It is a fundamental research position focused on due diligence, risk assessment, and strategic advisory. You will help ICH navigate the complex landscape of blockchain technology, ensuring that our exposure to digital assets is compliant, secure, and aligned with long-term corporate goals. Key Responsibilities Fundamental Research & Due Diligence: Conduct deep-dive analysis of Web3 sectors (DeFi, Infrastructure, RWA, Layer 2s, Gaming). Evaluate projects based on technology, team credibility, tokenomics, and market fit. Investment Thesis Development: Create and maintain actionable investment theses for the CIO and Board. Identify undervalued opportunities and potential risks in the crypto market. On-Chain Analytics: Utilize tools like Dune Analytics, Nansen, Etherscan, and DefiLlama to verify project metrics, track user growth, monitor whale activity, and assess network health. Tokenomics Modeling: Analyze token distribution models, vesting schedules, inflation rates, and utility mechanisms to identify sustainable projects vs. speculative pumps. Executive Reporting: Prepare concise, high-impact investment memorandums and weekly market intelligence briefings for senior leadership. Regulatory & Risk Monitoring: Stay updated on global regulatory developments (including Brazil’s CVM guidelines, MiCA in EU, and VARA in UAE) and assess their impact on ICH’s strategy. Portfolio Support: Monitor existing digital asset holdings or pilot projects, providing regular performance reports and rebalancing recommendations. Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of experience in financial research, equity analysis, or venture capital, with at least 2–3 years specifically focused on Crypto/Web3 assets. Technical Depth: Strong understanding of blockchain fundamentals (consensus mechanisms, smart contracts, DeFi primitives, ZK-proofs). Ability to read technical whitepapers and audit reports. Analytical Skills: Proficiency in financial modeling (Excel/Google Sheets) and on-chain data analysis tools (Dune, Nansen, Arkham, Glassnode). SQL or Python skills are a strong plus. Market Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the global crypto landscape, including key players, narratives (e.G., RWA, AI x Crypto), and market cycles. Communication: Exceptional written English for reporting to international executives. Portuguese is native/preferred for local coordination. Integrity: High ethical standards and attention to detail. You are skeptical by nature and rely on data, not hype. Compensation & Benefits Competitive Salary: $105,000 - $150,000 USD per year (adjusted for experience and location). Performance Bonus: Annual bonus tied to the accuracy of research insights and successful identification of opportunities. Flexible

You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You’ll DoProduct Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKESThe Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key SkillsVisionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values:Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFERTrust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula – onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas – até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará – com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas – as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.

Vantagens

  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade.
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.

  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.
Responsabilidades e Atribuições
  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep.

Informações Adicionais
  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio.
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam.
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social.
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho.
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais.

Sobre a MAG

Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos. Em 2009, nos associamos ao Grupo Aegon, presente em mais de 20 países ao redor do mundo. Hoje, somos a terceira maior seguradora independente do Brasil e contamos com 38 unidades de vendas físicas espalhadas pelo Brasil, que servem de base para o trabalho de mais de seis mil corretores parceiros.

Aqui na Construtora Tenda , nosso propósito é claro: desafiar o impossível para que mais pessoas conquistem o seu lugar no mundo .
